// diagnostic

E1229

Role namespace `{ns}` belongs in the module declaration name.

What

Role namespace `{ns}` belongs in the module declaration name.

Why

`module {name} { {ns}.{role}: {Type}.{ … } }` splits the role across two places; the canonical form puts it once, in the declaration name, so discovery-by-declaration (`module env.dev`) reads the role straight off the name (D-JPK-MODBODY1).

Fix

Write `module {ns}.{role} { … }` and move the contribution's fields up to the module body.
